description.value: Switch Cafe is a specialty coffee and breakfast spot on Ellis Street in downtown Kelowna, serving creative espresso drinks, premium matcha lattes, London Fog teas, and breakfast wraps. The café has earned a 5.0 rating on Uber Eats and offers a compact but inventive menu that includes tiramisu lattes and iced strawberry matcha. Its central Kelowna location on Ellis Street puts it within easy reach of cyclists passing through the city core.
